spans.s:
आध्मा आ-ध्मा, cl. 1. P. -धमति, -ध्मातुम्,
to inflate, puff up; to sound.

आ-ध्मात, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, sounding; inflated,
burnt; (अस्), m. flatulence, borborygmi, swelling of
the abdomen with noise, war, battle.

आ-ध्मान, अम्, n. blowing, inflation; boasting;
a bellows; intumescence, swelling of the body, dropsy.
आ-ध्मापन, अम्, n. a means of inflating.
